org_loyalty.name: org_loyalty
org_loyalty.value: "org"."loyalty_earn_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "org"."loyalty_point_value" >= 0 AND "org"."loyalty_expiry_days" >= 0 AND "org"."tier_notice_days" >= 0 AND (NOT "org"."loyalty_enabled" OR "org"."loyalty_point_value" > 0)

org_statements.name: org_statements
org_statements.value: "org"."statement_schedule" IN ('off', 'monthly') AND "org"."statement_day" BETWEEN 1 AND 28 AND "org"."statement_channels" <@ ARRAY['sms', 'email']::text[] AND "org"."statement_min_balance" >= 0 AND ("org"."statement_schedule" = 'off' OR cardinality("org"."statement_channels") > 0)

audit_chain_shape.name: audit_chain_shape
audit_chain_shape.value: ("audit_log"."hash" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" IS NULL AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" IS NULL) OR ("audit_log"."hash" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "audit_log"."hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "audit_log"."prev_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "audit_log"."chain_seq" > 0)

barcode_mapping_slices.name: barcode_mapping_slices
barcode_mapping_slices.value: "barcode_mapping"."product_start" >= 2 AND "barcode_mapping"."product_length" >= 1 AND "barcode_mapping"."product_start" + "barcode_mapping"."product_length" <= 12 AND "barcode_mapping"."value_start" >= 2 AND "barcode_mapping"."value_length" >= 1 AND "barcode_mapping"."value_start" + "barcode_mapping"."value_length" <= 12 AND ("barcode_mapping"."product_start" + "barcode_mapping"."product_length" <= "barcode_mapping"."value_start" OR "barcode_mapping"."value_start" + "barcode_mapping"."value_length" <= "barcode_mapping"."product_start")

barcode_mapping_kind.name: barcode_mapping_kind
barcode_mapping_kind.value: ("barcode_mapping"."kind" = 'weight' AND "barcode_mapping"."unit" IN ('g', 'kg')) OR ("barcode_mapping"."kind" = 'price' AND "barcode_mapping"."unit" IS NULL)

tax_rates.name: tax_rates
tax_rates.value: "tax_rule"."vat_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."nhil_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."getfund_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 AND "tax_rule"."covid_bps" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000

registration_audit_chain_shape.name: registration_audit_chain_shape
registration_audit_chain_shape.value: "registration_audit_log"."hash" IS NOT NULL AND "registration_audit_log"."prev_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "registration_audit_log"."chain_seq" IS NOT NULL AND "registration_audit_log"."hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "registration_audit_log"."prev_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "registration_audit_log"."chain_seq" > 0

asset_policy.name: asset_policy
asset_policy.value: ("asset"."purpose" = 'catalogue_import' AND "asset"."bucket" = 'imports' AND "asset"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("asset"."purpose" = 'sync_snapshot' AND "asset"."bucket" = 'snapshots' AND "asset"."expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("asset"."purpose" = 'sale_receipt' AND "asset"."bucket" = 'receipts' AND "asset"."expires_at" IS NULL)

stock_document_receipt_source.name: stock_document_receipt_source
stock_document_receipt_source.value: "stock_document"."kind" <> 'receipt' OR "stock_document"."device_id" IS NOT NULL OR "stock_document"."supplier_id" IS NOT NULL

stock_movement_document.name: stock_movement_document
stock_movement_document.value: "stock_movement"."reason" NOT IN ('count', 'receipt') OR "stock_movement"."document_id" IS NOT NULL

stock_take_line_count_set.name: stock_take_line_count_set
stock_take_line_count_set.value: ("stock_take_line"."counted_thousandths" IS NULL) = ("stock_take_line"."counted_at" IS NULL) AND ("stock_take_line"."counted_at" IS NULL) = ("stock_take_line"."counted_by" IS NULL)

shift_movement_kind.name: shift_movement_kind
shift_movement_kind.value: ("shift_movement"."kind" = 'drop' AND "shift_movement"."amount" > 0) OR ("shift_movement"."kind" = 'no_sale' AND "shift_movement"."amount" = 0 AND "shift_movement"."reason" IS NOT NULL)

customer_merged.name: customer_merged
customer_merged.value: "customer"."merged_into_id" IS NULL OR "customer"."archived_at" IS NOT NULL

account_hold_size.name: account_hold_size
account_hold_size.value:
("account_hold"."kind" = 'credit' AND "account_hold"."amount" > 0 AND "account_hold"."points" IS NULL AND "account_hold"."point_value" IS NULL)
        OR ("account_hold"."kind" = 'loyalty' AND "account_hold"."points" > 0 AND "account_hold"."point_value" > 0 AND "account_hold"."amount" IS NULL)

credit_entry_sign.name: credit_entry_sign
credit_entry_sign.value:
"credit_entry"."kind" = 'transfer' OR ("credit_entry"."kind" IN ('charge', 'interest') AND "credit_entry"."amount" > 0)
        OR ("credit_entry"."kind" IN ('payment', 'credit_note') AND "credit_entry"."amount" < 0)

loyalty_entry_sign.name: loyalty_entry_sign
loyalty_entry_sign.value: ("loyalty_entry"."reason" = 'earn' AND "loyalty_entry"."points" > 0) OR ("loyalty_entry"."reason" IN ('redeem', 'expire') AND "loyalty_entry"."points" < 0) OR "loyalty_entry"."reason" IN ('reverse', 'transfer')

kyc_case_request.name: kyc_case_request
kyc_case_request.value:
("kyc_case"."purpose" = 'credit' AND "kyc_case"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kyc_case"."requested_limit" > 0 AND "kyc_case"."requested_role_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("kyc_case"."purpose" = 'role' AND "kyc_case"."member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kyc_case"."requested_role_id" IS NOT NULL AND "kyc_case"."requested_limit" IS NULL)

kyc_case_id.name: kyc_case_id
kyc_case_id.value: ("kyc_case"."id_type" IS NULL) = ("kyc_case"."id_fingerprint" IS NULL) AND ("kyc_case"."id_type" IS NULL) = ("kyc_case"."id_masked" IS NULL)

kyc_case_decision.name: kyc_case_decision
kyc_case_decision.value: ("kyc_case"."decided_by" IS NULL) = ("kyc_case"."decided_at" IS NULL) AND ("kyc_case"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'rejected') OR "kyc_case"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL)

fiscal_doc_accepted.name: fiscal_doc_accepted
fiscal_doc_accepted.value: "fiscal_doc"."status" <> 'accepted' OR ("fiscal_doc"."signature" IS NOT NULL AND "fiscal_doc"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL)
